This happens even when the gate holds (plan_files_outside_files_touched at the elif near line 1132/1133, or identity_unavailable at line 1121) and even when no plan path needed the companion allowance.
  WHY: agents.d/8956-auto-heal-companion-scope.md line 7 and changelog.d/8956-auto-heal-companion-scope.md line 10 say the key marks an approving record that used the rule, so the audit trail is false; test_plan_gate_auto_heal_companions covers only the approve case. All reviewers rated it NIT.
- scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py:548-549 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `_AUTO_HEAL_CONTRACT_RE = re.compile(r"^db/contracts/[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*\.yml$")` requires an alphanumeric first character, so it rejects contracts that start with `_` (for example `db/contracts/_locks.yml`) or with `.`.
  WHY: A trusted remediation plan that touches such a contract is still held with plan_files_outside_files_touched, and the implement guard refuses it. This fails closed but does not meet "accept db/contracts/*.yml". All three rated it NIT; reviewers cite line 548 or 549 for this regex.
- scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py:549-550 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `_AUTO_HEAL_TEST_RE = re.compile(r"^tests/test_[A-Za-z0-9_]+\.py$")` rejects hyphens (and dots) in test names, which the `tests/test_*.py` glob would accept.
  WHY: A trusted auto-heal plan with a hyphen-named test file (for example `tests/test-streaks-quest-contracts.py`) is denied at the plan gate and at the implement guard, which brings back the #8956 stall for that path shape. Severities disagree: minimax rated it MAJOR and gemini NIT; the highest is used here.
- scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py:562-576 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: auto_heal_companions_allowed returns True on author_login == pipeline_login plus a _AUTO_HEAL_REMEDIATION_RE match. Unlike build_automation_grant (lines 397-413), it does not call check_origin_chain.
  WHY: The re-issue path in scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh (lines 7401-7406) copies `${issue_body}` verbatim. A person-written issue carrying the marker therefore gets companion scope after a pipeline re-issue, which the issue's security constraint forbids (SEVERITY: NIT).
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:2123-2128 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: When the login fails the shape check, the `IMPLEMENT_SCOPE_PIPELINE_LOGIN` export block leaves the variable unset without logging anything, so the three downstream callers silently get an empty pipeline-login.
  WHY: This degrades operational diagnostics only. Fail-closed is the intended behaviour, and no logic defect or trust-boundary widening results (SEVERITY: NIT).
- .github/workflows (check-run context, not the diff):copilot-pull-request-reviewer | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The failed check `copilot-pull-request-reviewer` on head SHA 651ee479bfcfb92f70f091e3e334f5cea94065a5 returned HTTP 422 `errorCode: custom_instructions_too_large`.
  WHY: The PR does not modify AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md. The failure comes from the Copilot action's own prompt-size limit and maps to no diff hunk (SEVERITY: NIT).

  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]

  WHY: Repo test jobs were still in_progress (collection_status: timeout), so this cannot be confirmed. If the failures are real, the editor must re-run the named suites and fix them before merge (SEVERITY: NIT).

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py:auto_heal_companions_allowed (around lines 562-576) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The helper returns True on author_login == pipeline_login plus a _AUTO_HEAL_REMEDIATION_RE match, with no check_origin_chain call (unlike build_automation_grant, lines 397-413). The re-issue path in scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh (lines 7401-7406) copies "${issue_body}" verbatim.
  WHY: A person-written issue with "<!-- auto-heal-remediation:v1 " gets db/contracts/*.yml and tests/test_*.py scope after a pipeline re-issue, in both the plan gate (lines 1116-1120) and the implement CLI (lines 1853-1859), which the security constraint forbids.
- scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py:run_plan_auto_approval_gate, lines 1119-1120 and lines 1160-1161 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: auto_heal_companions is set whenever the issue qualifies, including on hold records (elif at line 1132, plan_files_outside_files_touched) and on approvals that list no companion path.
  WHY: The behaviour contradicts agents.d/8956-auto-heal-companion-scope.md line 7 and changelog.d/8956-auto-heal-companion-scope.md, so the audit trail is false; test_plan_gate_auto_heal_companions checks only the approve case.
- scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py:_AUTO_HEAL_CONTRACT_RE = re.compile(r"^db/contracts/[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*\.yml$") | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The alphanumeric first character rejects `_`-prefixed contracts such as db/contracts/_locks.yml.
  WHY: A trusted remediation plan that adds an index on that collection is still held, and the implement guard refuses the staged contract. This fails closed, and the ".." check already guards traversal.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS (3 related items), HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1: (a) set auto_heal_companions only on PLAN_DECISION_APPROVE when a companion path is actually needed (3-4 lines); (b) return False from auto_heal_companions_allowed when origin_references(issue_body) finds any source reference (3 lines); (c) change the first character class of _AUTO_HEAL_CONTRACT_RE to [A-Za-z0-9_] (1 line).
